source: explicit project assets — user-supplied SimpleElm brand identity sheets (light + dark)

approved_direction.name: SimpleElm
references: AI-forward product tours (glowing 3D hero objects, neural-network motifs)
interactive ML/AI learning tools (loss-curve visualizations, live simulations)
approved_direction.photography: No photography of people. Abstract 3D renders and generative/AI visuals only: glowing gradient S-mark on a pedestal, neural network node graphs, holographic geometric grids, silhouette-in-portal compositions. Consistent blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting across every image.
approved_direction.iconography: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states. Domain set: home, courses (book), labs (flask), AI playground (brain), learning paths (route), community (users), assistant/help (message-circle).
approved_direction.density: Medium density bento-style grid of feature tiles and stat cards; confident whitespace between sections; data/interactive panels (loss curve, simulator) are allowed to be denser than marketing sections.
approved_direction.personality: Friendly, modern, AI-forward, confident but approachable — 'learn deep concepts, simply.' Technical credibility without being cold or corporate.
approved_direction.layout_style: Centered hero with large 3D gradient mark, bento grid of feature tiles, dedicated interactive-learning module (sliders + live chart), mixed asymmetric proof/vision sections, consistent card-with-icon-tile pattern.
approved_direction.hero_style: Centered, product-forward hero: headline + subhead + dual CTA beside a glowing 3D brand mark composition.
approved_direction.cta_tone: ابدأ التعلم الآن / استكشف الكورسات — start learning, explore courses, try the AI playground.

theming.mechanism: data-theme attribute on <html>, persisted in localStorage

copy_tone: Arabic-first and confident, technical but warm
spacing_observations: marketing sections breathe; interactive/data panels stay denser and functional
